registry_title: Remote Sensing Scientific Source and Index Registry
description: Curated registry of official product specifications, peer-reviewed indices, spectral libraries, training materials, and scientific discovery catalogs for Earth observation.

provenance.hierarchy_rule: Primary research papers and official agency mission documentation outrank educational tutorials and community scripts. Code repositories illustrate implementation syntax but do not prove scientific validity.

sources.title: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Science Products Scaling and Specifications
authoritative_for: Landsat C2 L2 SR scaling: reflectance = DN * 0.0000275 - 0.2
Landsat C2 L2 Surface Temperature: ST = DN * 0.00341802 + 149.0 (Kelvin)
QA_PIXEL bitmask definitions for clouds, shadow, dilation, and water

sources.title: Landsat Surface Reflectance-Derived Spectral Indices
authoritative_for: Landsat pre-packaged spectral indices definitions
Ready-made product scale factor: stored as int16 with scale factor 0.0001 (range -10000 to 10000)

sources.title: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem - Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A Processing
authoritative_for: Sentinel-2 band spatial resolutions (10m, 20m, 60m)
Scene Classification Layer (SCL) classes (0=NoData, 1=Saturated, 3=Cloud Shadow, 4=Vegetation, 5=Bare Soil, 6=Water, 7=Unclassified, 8=Cloud Medium, 9=Cloud High, 10=Cirrus, 11=Snow)
Processing baselines (e.g. PB 04.00+ reflectance offset -1000 DN)

sources.title: Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) Science Products
authoritative_for: NBAR (Nadir BRDF-Adjusted Reflectance)
Sensor bandpass alignment between OLI and MSI
Consistent 30m grid time-series metrics

sources.title: Awesome Spectral Indices Catalog

authoritative_for: Standardized formula naming and community index definitions

sources.title: Index DataBase (IDB) for Remote Sensing Indices
sources.organization: University of Bonn / Remote Sensing Working Group
authoritative_for: Cross-mapping of specific satellite sensor bands to mathematical indices
Hyperspectral and multispectral band availability checks

sources.title: UN-SPIDER Recommended Practices for Disaster Risk Management
sources.organization: United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA)
authoritative_for: Multi-sensor flood mapping protocols (Sentinel-1 SAR + Sentinel-2 optical + DTM terrain mask)

sources.title: FAO WaPOR - Water Productivity through Open access of Remotely sensed derived data
authoritative_for: Actual Evapotranspiration (AETI) and transpiration fractions

sources.title: USGS High Spectral Resolution Reflectance Laboratory Spectral Library v7
authoritative_for: Diagnostic absorption features (e.g. 2.2 µm Al-OH clay, 2.35 µm Mg-OH/carbonate, 0.9 µm Fe3+)
